findings: Header identifies Socket.IO v4.8.1, Guillermo Rauch copyright and MIT license. This is header attribution, not an independent official-release byte comparison or complete transitive license audit.
Whole bundle includes Engine.IO framing/polling/WebSocket/WebTransport, parser, emitter, acknowledgements, retry queue, socket and manager lifecycle, URL parsing and manager multiplex cache.

Original bundled Manager with autoConnect false and fake timers schedules one reconnect timer; disconnect clears it and sets skipReconnect. App-wrapper independent timers from v8 remain a separate issue.

Disconnected socket retains unsent sendBuffer entry in isolated control. Future connection may flush buffered work; applications must define replay/idempotency semantics. No destructive operation replay demonstrated.
Source supports ack timeouts and retries but does not establish durable delivery or transactional file operations. Not a duplicate-matching algorithm.
